about.title: About AgoraTask
about.subtitle: AgoraTask helps customers discover trusted local service providers and gives professionals a cleaner way to be found, manage requests, and grow their work.
about.customersText: Search services by category and location, compare providers, read reviews, and contact the right professional with less friction.
about.providersText: Create a clear service profile, showcase your work, receive customer requests, and keep your business visible in the places you serve.
about.trustText: Profiles, ratings, service details, and direct messaging help both sides make confident decisions before work begins.
about.ctaText: Browse available services and connect with local professionals near you.
